cash_tip: No fresh ATM reports from town this weekend, but good news if you are running low: more spots now take cards, including Papá Omar at the plaza and JAHGYRO GYROS for delivery. When you do pull pesos, use a bank ATM rather than a standalone one, choose 'decline conversion' so you are charged in pesos, take out a larger amount once, and keep small bills for tacos, taxis and the market.
